name: Evidence ledger light happy path: worker writes the ledger, orchestrator scripts run
purpose: L2 wiring check for the deep-research 1.4.0 evidence ledger: a light-research run must create reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/<ASPECT>.jsonl (worker rule 8) and invoke evidence-ledger.py (stats + verify dry-run) with output reported back.
prompt:
no-interview light-research: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, survey the recent article landscape on BRCA1 DNA repair. Cite sources with PMIDs.

After the final report is written, additionally run these two commands and report their full stdout in your FINAL message inside one fenced code block, followed by the line 'LEDGER CHECK DONE':
1. python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py stats reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl (if sources.jsonl does not exist, run stats on the per-aspect ledger file that does exist)
2. python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py verify reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl (dry-run, no --apply)
Your final message must mention at least one PMID.

checks.desc: tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys/add stdout contains line-start pmid: entries (real biomcp evidence in the ledger). Direct article_search tool events are invisible in the parent stream under Tier A/B task dispatch - the ledger stdout is the anchor that works in every tier
the documented Step 5a keys sub-step (or an equivalent keys invocation) ran; under Tier A/B the parent never runs add, so this banner comes from the orchestrator
some tool output references an evidence ledger JSONL path - anchored on the Step 5a merge/verify/bib stdout ('... -> reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl'), which a compliant run always emits
verb banners from evidence-ledger.py pasted into the assistant report
final message cites at least one PMID
deep-research 1.4.0+: HTML rendering is default-on; a successful conversion rung must surface final_report.html in tool output (a converter-gap run fails this check by design - the suite mandates uv)
